Name: Azariah, Son of Ethan
Summary: Son of Ethan, named as the son of Ethan in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:8: Son of Ethan, named as the son of Ethan in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
